name: Herbs For Healing
overview: Scripture reveals that God, in His sovereign design, created herbs and plants to serve humanity and all living creatures as provision for sustenance and healing. From the beginning, He gave every herb bearing seed for food (Genesis 1:29-30) and affirmed their role in the natural order (Genesis 1:11, 9:3). Moreover, God's healing power is emphasized in His promise to protect His people from disease when they obey Him (Exodus 15:26), and He prescribed the use of specific spices and herbs in sacred rituals (Exodus 30:34), demonstrating their significance in both physical and spiritual health.
